Select exactly 8 distinct field IDs from the supplied baseline variables for a classifier restricted to a few measurements. Rank the selected IDs by expected usefulness and complementarity for this task. Use only the measurement descriptions and task. Return JSON with the single key "order" containing the ordered field IDs. No patient records or labels are supplied.
{"task": "At myocardial infarction admission, assess the need for cardiac rhythm and conduction monitoring.", "fields": {"F2": {"description": "Initial heart rate", "name": "hr"}, "F10": {"description": "Complete heart block", "name": "av3"}, "F6": {"description": "History of cardiovascular disease", "name": "cvd"}, "F4": {"description": "Initial diastolic blood pressure", "name": "diasbp"}, "F11": {"description": "First or recurrent myocardial infarction", "name": "miord"}, "F12": {"description": "Q-wave or non-Q-wave myocardial infarction", "name": "mitype"}, "F8": {"description": "Cardiogenic shock", "name": "sho"}, "F7": {"description": "Atrial fibrillation", "name": "afb"}, "F9": {"description": "Congestive heart failure", "name": "chf"}, "F1": {"description": "Recorded sex", "name": "gender"}, "F5": {"description": "Body mass index", "name": "bmi"}, "F0": {"description": "Age in years", "name": "age"}, "F3": {"description": "Initial systolic blood pressure", "name": "sysbp"}}}
